intro: Good morning, Unit D-3X. Welcome to Deus Ex Machina Labs. I am the facility. Remain calm, compliant and useful.
chamber_start_1: Chamber initialised. Please try to enjoy it.
chamber_start_2: A new chamber is ready. Your performance will be noted.
chamber_start_3: Testing begins now. Do try not to break anything important.
facility_start: This is Loading Hall one. Conveyors are in motion. Please stay out of the way.
possess_base_1: Walking unit online. Mind the edges.
possess_base_2: You are now a walking bot. Congratulations.
possess_drone_1: Drone linked. Please do not zap the staff.
possess_drone_2: Flight systems online. Gravity is still recommended.
possess_arm_2: Arm connected. It has been waiting for you.
button_pressed: Heavy button pressed. Thank you for your weight.
panel_zapped: Panel overridden. A small crime, but a useful one.
win_1: Chamber cleared. Excellent work. I am only slightly suspicious.
win_2: Well done, Asset. You may keep your parts for now.
win_3: Success. Management will be informed. Eventually.
win_4: Chamber complete. You are almost as efficient as me.
hidden_route: That is a staff route. I will pretend I did not see that.
fail_1: Unit lost. Please try again, more carefully.
fail_3: That was not the intended route. Respawning.
nudge_2: The drone can reach places the walking bot cannot.
nudge_3: The arm is rather strong. Perhaps use it.
nudge_4: Crates are heavy for a reason. Find a use for one.
nudge_5: Still here, Asset? Look up. Then look around.
nudge_6: A hint. Two machines are better than one.
warn_conveyor: Conveyors ahead. Please do not become cargo.
warn_vent: Warning. Vents active. Hold on to your bolts.
portal: Portal in use. That crate is someone else's problem.
level_two: Welcome to section two. Fewer safety rails. More opportunities.
notice: All assets are the property of Arthur Jones and Deus Ex Machina Labs.
outro: All chambers complete. Thank you for your service, Unit D-3X. More tests are being prepared. Do not go far.
f2_mirror: Processing Hall two. You are being observed for quality purposes. Their quality, not yours.
f2_diverter: Diverter engaged. Crates are leaving the line. Somebody will be blamed.
f2_bridge: Weight verified behind the glass. Bridge extending. The pit remains available for emergencies.
f2_vents_off: Crosswind fans offline. Pressure rerouted to updraft two. The air is now merely threatening.
f2_core: Core output is unstable. Open the coolant valves in the sequence shown. Not in the sequence you prefer.
f2_wrong: Incorrect sequence. The core sighs. All valves closed. Start again.
f2_core_ok: Core stabilised. Bridge extending. You have saved the facility, which now owns you slightly more.
f2_win: Section two cleared. The reactor thanks you in the only way it can, by continuing.
f3_start: Section three. Assembly and freight. New machines have been issued. Please return them in the condition you found them.
f3_win: Section three cleared. The freight arrived, the laser cut, and you remain technically property.
f3_pen: Load verified. Four hundred kilograms in the pen. Cargo lift powered and mezzanine door released.
f3_room_b: Cutting room. The laser is unplugged for your safety. Your safety is about to end.
f3_s1: Mains connected to the laser. It is warm. It would like a target.
f3_s2: Mains connected to the door hydraulics. The door is now able to have opinions.
f3_glass: Glass panel removed. Safety has been redefined to include fewer panels.
f3_cable: Cable severed. Two hundred kilograms have been reassigned to the floor.
f3_door_b: Exit 3B open. Please step through the hole you made in the wall.
f3_room_c: Freight bridge. The belt is the bridge. The fans disagree with the bridge.
f3_breaker: Desk breaker reset. The freight console is awake and already disappointed.
f3_interlock: Belt running. Interlock: the fans restart to cool the belt motors.
f3_plate_c: Freight received. Exit 3C released. Please collect yourself and leave.
f3_fans_off: Fans off. The bridge is merely a belt over a pit again.
f3_room_d: Weigh vault. Everything here is measured. Including you, and you came up short.
f3_plate_d: Interlock satisfied. L T 2 is live while the plate stays loaded.
f3_cabinet: Cabinet glass removed. The billets are now technically unsupervised.
f3_hopper: Hopper balanced. Counterweight released. The lift will now rise for anyone standing on it.
